Change the User-Agent reported to websites

Choose a User-Agent for website compatibility. Desktop site is controlled separately in the menu and site settings; your site exceptions are preserved. A custom string is used in both modes. Changing the User-Agent does not change the browser engine or make the browser anonymous.
Enter a User-Agent of up to 1024 printable ASCII characters.
The change applies after restarting the browser. Until then, all pages keep the current User-Agent. Save any text you have entered on websites before restarting.
Could not save the setting. The browser was not restarted. Try again.
A new custom User-Agent is saved. The previous string stays active until the browser restarts.
